definitions.gloss: to make, to create, to produce
definitions.explanation: To bring something into existence through effort or skill. Used for cooking, crafting, building, or creating anything.
To arrange or set up something. {計画|けいかく}を{作|つく}る (to make a plan), リストを{作|つく}る (to make a list).

examples.japanese: {晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}を{作|つく}ります。
この{机|つくえ}は{木|き}で{作|つく}られています。
examples.english: This desk is made of wood.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}を{作|つく}りたいです。

notes: {作|つく}る is one of the most common verbs in Japanese. Te-form: {作|つく}って. The kanji {造|つく}る is used for larger-scale production (ships, buildings), and {創|つく}る for creative/artistic creation, but {作|つく}る is the most general and common.
